key.name: menu-type
key.description: Choose between the different types of menus.

key.name: terminal
key.description:
Command to open terminal.
Default: ptyxis -- bash -c
Test: ptyxis -- bash -c 'echo test; read'
Test: gnome-terminal -- bash -c 'echo test; read'
Test: terminator -e 'echo test; read'

key.name: submenu-text
key.description: How much height in pixels in the submenu text. Only visible when are more containers/images than the size screen.

key.name: submenu-image
key.description: How much height in pixels in the submenu image. Only visible when are more containers/images than the size screen.

key.name: up-containers-timer
key.description: Delay to refresh the number of containers up. Set to 0 to disable.

key.name: quicksettings-columns
key.description: Decides how many items per row the menu will show.

key.name: show-health
key.description: Show container health status indicator and health section when expanded.

key.name: logs-include-previous
key.description: Show previous log lines when viewing container or compose logs. When disabled, only new log lines are shown.

key.name: logs-tail-length
key.description: How many previous log lines to show. Only applies when "Include previous logs" is enabled.
